Nora (Marketing): Rapid check-in from today's micro-launch — solid early lift but want tighter attribution before scale.
Dev (Growth): Signup uplift ~+3% from post A. We'll run a 30/70 split for high-credit vs baseline.
Lina (Product): Need telemetry to show template adoption vs free-form prompts. Can we capture 'used_template' flag?
Sam (Eng): Yep, will emit used_template and tokens_per_session. Routing JSON I'll push to staging.
Priya (Ops): Routing rule (pseudocode):
```
if lead.source == "webinar" and lead.segment in ["startup","pm"]:
  enroll = "high_credit" # 30% rollout
else:
  enroll = "baseline"
```
Nora (Marketing): Creative plan: 1) benchmark teaser (internal ranges only), 2) template quickstart post, 3) webinar CTA. Drafts by EOD.
Dev (Growth): Targets: 7-day activation and 14-day retention. Also track avg tokens and % sessions labelled useful.
Lina (Product): Webinar set Thu 11am PT. Speakers: Lina + Sam + customer Casey. Demo flow must finish <6m.
Priya (Ops): I'll gate the high-credit arm to 30% and add a spend alert at $350/day. If triggered, rollback to 10%.
Sam (Eng): Pushing router JSON & metric tags to staging tomorrow morning.
Nora (Marketing): Action items: Nora publish drafts, Dev configure A/B, Sam push metrics, Priya set gates. Sync Mon 9am PT. :rocket:
